_doc: The four movement styles every species picks one of (species.json ai.style), used by FightStyle for any creature the AI plays. brawler: walks straight in. kiter: keeps `keep` px away (more when below `flee_below` life: `flee_keep`), backs off slower than it chases. tank: advances slowly (`advance` x speed), holds its ground, and channels its status move when hurt below `guard_below`. flanker: circles `flank` px to your side, strikes, runs `retreat` px off for `retreat_time` s, comes again.
